## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is Agenda Hero free?

Agenda Hero has a free tier ($0) that includes Agenda Hero Magic, Magic Pages, and Collaborative Calendars. Paid plans, as of June 2026, are Plus at $30 per user per year (billed annually) for unlimited AI edits and custom page URLs, and Organizations at $40 per year per account with a 10-seat minimum. Check agendahero.com/pricing for current details.

### What is the best Agenda Hero alternative?

If you want the same text-to-event parsing but faster and inside your browser, Text to Calendar is the closest alternative. It turns a highlight-and-right-click into a Google Calendar or Outlook event with no side panel or separate site, and it offers a dedicated Outlook extension that Agenda Hero handles as an export option. [...] If you're comparing Agenda Hero with Text to Calendar, the short answer is this: both use AI to turn messy text into calendar events, but they aim at different jobs. Agenda Hero is a full calendar product with a side panel, shareable "Magic Pages," and a directory of pre-built academic calendars; it exports to Google, Apple, and Outlook. Text to Calendar is a lightweight browser extension that lives where you already read text, turning a highlight into a Google Calendar or Outlook event with a right-click and no separate app to open. If you want a calendar destination and curated school schedules, Agenda Hero is the better fit. If you just want the fastest path from selected text to a saved event, Text to Calendar wins. Here is the honest breakdown.

## What Agenda Hero does [...] ### Does Agenda Hero work with Outlook?

Yes. Agenda Hero can add parsed events to Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, and Office 365, or email you the invite. For an Outlook-first workflow, Text to Calendar offers a dedicated Text to Outlook Calendar extension built specifically for Outlook and Microsoft 365.

### Can Agenda Hero turn a PDF or photo into calendar events?

Yes. Agenda Hero Magic accepts typed text, pasted text, photos, screenshots, and PDFs, and converts them into events you can edit. This is a key difference from Text to Calendar, which parses selectable text you highlight in the browser rather than images or PDFs.

## What is Agenda Hero?

The essentials

Agenda Hero Magic is an AI assistant specialized in converting raw information into calendar events. The user copy-pastes text, uploads an image (for example a concert flyer) or a PDF (a conference program), and the AI extracts the relevant events: title, date, time, location, description. The events can then be added in one click to Google, Apple or Outlook, or grouped into customizable Magic Pages that can be shared with an audience. A Chrome extension makes it easy to convert from any web page.

## Key features [...] Managing your calendar can be more time-consuming than you’d think. Between confirmation emails, event flyers, program PDFs or appointment texts, a busy day can require half an hour of manual entry. Agenda Hero Magic offers a radical solution: letting AI read this content and automatically extract the events to drop them into Google, Apple or Outlook. Designed for individuals as well as organizations, the platform goes further with a conversational Magic Chat, collaborative calendars and customizable pages. In this article, we look at what this calendar assistant concretely brings, its features, its price and the profiles that will benefit the most.

## What is Agenda Hero?

The essentials [...] ## Pricing

Agenda Hero Magic relies on a very accessible grid. The Free plan is free and includes Magic Pages as well as collaborative calendars, ideal for individual use. The Plus plan is billed at $30 per user per year, i.e. $2.50/month, and unlocks unlimited AI editing, graphic customization and custom URLs. The Organizations plan is offered at $40/account/year with a minimum of 10 users, designed for companies, associations or local authorities. The value for money is particularly attractive compared to the time saved on manual event entry.
